scope: Every whole action contact sheet, 16 normal opaque frames, dark/light; selected 3x joint and root inspection. This does not replace independent extend/subassembly range tests.
resolvedInThisReceipt: No neighboring body spike at neck root observed in all 112 whole-character frames. Precision source mask is active.
Feet contain claws rather than shoes in source and actual PNG.
Walk/run each leg has genuine half-cycle alternation; each inner freeze/same-phase injection was rejected.
No extra third bone node exists: upper and lower plus foot. Source shape still creates a secondary kink impression.
Roar/bite source skull is upper jaw and separate jaw owns lower teeth; no duplicated closed-jaw strip was confirmed in enlarged output.
notReviewed: Actual game collision, slopes and world motion
Browser SVG/Canvas visual equivalence and measured frame rate
limitations: Near/far legs may correctly hide locally; jumping obstruction finding concerns whole-clip readability, not a rule requiring both legs visible in every frame.
No real T-rex locomotion footage exists. Motion quality is an animation design judgment, not a scientific dinosaur gait validation.
